Use target_id only for socialize plans; otherwise set target_id to null.
If baseline_plan is present, treat it as the deterministic rule baseline: you may follow it or diverge, but the reason must cite concrete evidence from needs, memories, reflections, events, resources, or decision_pressure.
Do not choose rest only because energy is imperfect. Under food, material, shelter, or shock pressure, weigh personal recovery against shared production and repair needs.
